#!/bin/bash
# Compile the student's Java file if ! javac Practica05B.java; then echo "Compilation Error" exit 1 fi
echo "Compilation successful"
# Initialize score score=0
evaluate_case() { local input="$1" local expected="$2" local description="$3"
echo -e "$input" | java Practica05B > output.txt if diff -q <(echo "$expected") output.txt > /dev/null; then echo "[PASSED] $description" score=$((score + 1)) else echo "[FAILED] $description" echo "Expected: $expected" echo "Got:" cat output.txt fi }
# Exercise 1: Quiz test evaluate_case "1
